item.title: A peek at the APEC CEO Summit
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-19
Why did representatives from 115 Fortune Global 500 companies come to Shenzhen? They were among the business leaders gathered for the APEC CEO Summit on Nov 17-18, and one big question was where to find new opportunities. China is already a major market, but as I heard at the summit, global companies are now looking beyond sales to China's technology, talent and innovation.

item.title: Three postcards, one journey of opportunity in Shenzhen
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-19
Before heading to Shenzhen to cover APEC, China Daily reporter Zhao Manfeng received three postcards. Following the postmarks, she set out to find their senders: Jeong Songhwa from South Korea, Ma Junbang from China, and Truong Le Na from Vietnam — representing APEC's previous, current and next host economies. Using their cameras to connect people across borders, the three young content creators explore opportunities in Shenzhen. From Gyeongju to Shenzhen to Phu Quoc, the APEC journey is opening doors for young people across the Asia-Pacific. In Shenzhen, they are making connections, pursuing opportunities and turning their dreams into reality.

item.title: China-Russia-US Heads of State Declaration toward Peace
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-19
SHENZHEN -- The following is the full text of the China-Russia-US Heads of State Declaration toward Peace, released on Thursday. Xi Jinping, President of the People's Republic of China, Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation, and Donald J. Trump, President of the United States of America, met in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. The Russian and US heads of state expressed appreciation to China for hosting this historic trilateral Summit. The three heads of state had an in-depth exchange of views on the current international situation and committed to maintaining strategic stability and international security. 1. As permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, China, Russia, and the United States committed to reform the UN so that the UN can respond more effectively to global challenges and conform to its fundamental mission of international peace and security. 2. The three countries plan to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products for the benefit of all nations. They reaffirmed the importance of stable energy flows. 3. The three heads of state recognized that the principle of state consent and respect for immunities of State officials are of paramount importance, and concurred that the International Criminal Court and other similar bodies must not abuse their jurisdiction. 4. The three heads of state reaffirmed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought. The three countries will conduct a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons.

item.title: Xi makes four points on how major countries should get along with each other
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-19
SHENZHEN -- President Xi Jinping on Thursday made four points on how major countries could find the right way to get along and jointly underpin world peace. Major countries should uphold mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, win-win cooperation, and dialogue and consultation, Xi said at a summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen, South China's Guangdong province. Xi said that countries should respect one another's sovereignty and territorial integrity, respect the social systems and development paths of their own choice, and respect each other's core interests and major concerns. They should not interfere in other countries' domestic affairs or each other's internal affairs, he said. On major sensitive issues concerning one another, it is important to communicate in advance, try to see things from one another's perspective, act with caution, and in particular, not to challenge the red lines of one another, Xi said. Xi said that China, Russia and the United States should be partners and friends. They should not go for conflict or confrontation among themselves, but should hold the line on peaceful coexistence and make efforts to avoid the Thucydides Trap. As the main victors of World War II, China, Russia and the United States should steadfastly safeguard the postwar international order, Xi said. He said that nuclear weapons, the Sword of Damocles that hangs over humanity, should be completely prohibited and thoroughly destroyed over time to make the world free of nuclear weapons. He emphasized the importance of win-win cooperation. The three countries should strengthen economic cooperation and trade, combine their respective strengths as major countries in resources, manufacturing and consumption, so as to make the pie of cooperation bigger and achieve win-win and all-win outcomes. Decoupling and disruption of industrial and supply chains are not the way to go. Xi said that the three countries could strengthen communication and coordination to safeguard the security and stability of the global energy market. He said that the three countries should maintain regular high-level exchanges, keep dialogue channels open at all levels, and establish crisis communication and prevention mechanisms to ensure that misjudgments occur less, differences can be managed, and frictions will not escalate. Xi said that China, Russia and the United States should continue to encourage parties to a conflict to sit down and talk, and settle disputes through political and diplomatic means.

item.title: China-Russia-US summit positive, constructive, fruitful: Xi
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-19
SHENZHEN -- President Xi Jinping on Thursday said that the China-Russia-US summit has been positive, constructive and fruitful. Xi made the remarks while summarizing the main consensus reached at the summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen, South China's Guangdong province. The three countries share the same view on safeguarding world peace, and all stressed that the hard-won peace must be cherished, Xi said. They all agree that major countries should take the legitimate security concerns of every country seriously and that dialogue and negotiation are the right choice to resolve differences, Xi said. "There is hope for peace as long as dialogue does not cease and the door does not close," Xi said. They also agreed that cooperation is essential to overcoming challenges, Xi said. The three countries should follow through on the consensus reached at the summit, continue to strengthen communication, promote peace through cooperation, and work together to build a better world.

item.title: Xi's speech boosts confidence in Asia-Pacific co-op
item.description:

President Xi Jinping delivered a keynote speech at the opening ceremony of the APEC CEO Summit 2026 in Shenzhen on Wednesday. International business leaders said his speech charted the course for greater openness, deeper cooperation and shared prosperity in the Asia-Pacific, while boosting global businesses' confidence in tapping into opportunities in China and expanding partnerships.

item.title: Xi meets Trump, calling for continued efforts to steer China-US relations on right course
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-19
SHENZHEN -- President Xi Jinping met with US President Donald Trump on Thursday in Shenzhen, calling for continued efforts to jointly steer the giant ship of China-US relations in the right direction toward the future. Trump is in the southern Chinese city for the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting on Nov 18-19. During the meeting, Xi said that China-US relations have generally maintained a stable and positive trajectory, bringing tangible benefits to people of both countries and injecting stability and certainty into the world. Xi said that he and Trump had jointly explored the right way for China and the United States, as two major countries, to get along, established a new vision to build a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability, and given it new substance grounded in respect, fairness and reciprocity. The new vision has been welcomed by the people of both China and the United States, as well as the international community, he added. Xi stressed that building a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability is an unprecedented and pioneering endeavor, adding that the key to sustaining the current positive momentum lies in taking concrete action to implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state. The two sides agreed to map out an action plan for building a constructive China-US relationship of strategic stability. Xi called on the two sides to strengthen communication on economic and trade matters, address each other's concerns, and work toward mutual benefit. The cooperation between the two countries on counternarcotics, repatriation of illegal immigrants, and combating telecommunications and online fraud has yielded positive results, Xi said, adding that it can be further deepened based on respect, fairness, and reciprocity. China and the United States should strengthen communication and coordination to guard against security risks of artificial intelligence and ensure that AI always remains under human control, he said. On the Taiwan question, the US side should keep doing the right thing and avoid major setbacks in China-US relations, Xi said. Trump said he and Xi have jointly guided the development of US-China relations, adding that both leaders have maintained close contact, with their friendship growing stronger. Trade and investment ties between the two countries have continued to grow, and cooperation on fentanyl and other issues has yielded results, Trump noted. He called on both sides to maintain the positive momentum of the stable development in bilateral relations and strengthen cooperation in areas such as farm products, energy and superintelligence. The United States does not support "Taiwan independence," Trump said. He congratulated China on hosting a successful APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, adding that both countries need to work together to lead and promote world peace and stability.

item.title: China is advocate, promoter, forerunner in Asia-Pacific economic cooperation: Xi
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-19
SHENZHEN -- President Xi Jinping on Thursday said China is an advocate, promoter and forerunner in Asia-Pacific economic cooperation, and it is ready to work with all parties to build the pillars that support an Asia-Pacific community. Xi made the remarks at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting, held in Shenzhen in South China's Guangdong province. Stressing the importance of stronger economic and trade ties underpinning such a community, Xi said efforts should be made to facilitate trade and investment, advance digitalization, and lower barriers to them. On upgrading connectivity, he called for measures to improve infrastructure networks, enhance coordination in policies and regulations, promote people-to-people exchanges, and foster mutual understanding and closer bonds among peoples. Emphasizing innovation, Xi said greater efforts need to be made to build digital infrastructure and promote the broad application of artificial intelligence. Xi stressed the importance of development, calling on regional economies to advance cooperation on energy and food security, anti-corruption governance across borders, and green and low-carbon transition. He also called for efforts to improve the people's well-being and increase investment in human capital.

item.title: Xi hosts welcome banquet for guests attending APEC meeting
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-18
SHENZHEN -- President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan, on Wednesday hosted a banquet in Shenzhen, South China's Guangdong province, to welcome guests who are here to attend the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting. "I wish to extend, on behalf of the Chinese government and the Chinese people, our warmest welcome to all distinguished guests," Xi said in his toast. Openness is deeply rooted in Shenzhen's DNA and innovation drives the city's vitality, while cooperation is where its strength comes from, Xi said, adding that the success of Shenzhen is also a microcosm of China's reform and opening up, as well as an example of fruitful cooperation across the Asia-Pacific. Noting that openness, innovation and cooperation have been the distinctive features of APEC since its establishment, Xi said APEC has grasped the pulse of the times and guided the process of regional economic integration, making the Asia-Pacific the most dynamic region and a vital growth engine of the world economy. "At tomorrow's Leaders' Meeting, we will discuss steps to expand mutual openness, explore pathways to innovation-driven growth, extend opportunities for result-oriented cooperation across various fields," Xi said. Before the banquet, Xi and Peng posed for group photos with leaders and representatives from APEC economies and their spouses. After the banquet, they joined the guests to watch an artistic performance.
